verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs show that errors can be segmented by custom tags and ranked by users affected, which implies tags and user identity travel with each event. The pack has no SDK-level documentation of how developers attach tags or user context, and never mentions breadcrumbs. Missing for 10: breadcrumb support, documented SDK APIs for setting custom tags and user context, arbitrary custom data per event, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach breadcrumbs, custom tags, and user context to every event so a stack trace arrives with the state that produced it

citations.quote: Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.
Raygun automatically captures detailed diagnostics for each and every error occurrence including full stack traces, method/function and class name data, OS, device, browser, location, host
